task_completion.description: Open the Webots simulation environment with the AGV model.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Webots application window is visible, showing a 3D scene with an AGV robot.

task_completion.description: Locate and select the CUSTOM_PAYLOAD Solid node in the scene tree.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'CUSTOM_PAYLOAD (Solid)' node is highlighted in the Webots scene tree (left sidebar).

task_completion.description: Update the mass of the CUSTOM_PAYLOAD to 120.0 kg.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the Scene Tree, under CUSTOM_PAYLOAD > physics > Physics > mass, the value is set to 120.

task_completion.description: Update the center of mass (centerOfMass) for the CUSTOM_PAYLOAD to 0.12 -0.05 0.18.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the Scene Tree, under CUSTOM_PAYLOAD > physics > Physics > centerOfMass, the vector is set to [0.12, -0.05, 0.18].

task_completion.description: Set the maxTorque for both left_motor and right_motor to 80.0 Nm.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the Scene Tree, under the AGV_BASE children, the maxTorque field for both 'left_motor' and 'right_motor' is visible and set to 80.

task_completion.description: Save the modified world to the specific path /home/ga/Desktop/agv_heavy_payload.wbt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save World As...' dialog box is shown with the path /home/ga/Desktop/agv_heavy_payload.wbt, or the file is visible on the Desktop after saving.

integrity.description: The agent used the Webots GUI to modify parameters rather than just editing the text file via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Webots Scene Tree fields and typing values into the property editor.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply run a python/bash script to overwrite the .wbt file without opening Webots.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Webots application is open and active throughout the configuration process.

integrity.description: The agent used the 'File > Save World As' menu or shortcut within the application.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Webots menu or file browser dialog is visible during the saving step.
